name: std::uninitialized_construct_using_allocator

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
p

 -

 the memory location where the object will be placed


 alloc

 -

 the allocator to use


 args

 -

 the arguments to pass to T's constructor

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Pointer to the newly-created object of type T.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: May throw any exception thrown by the constructor of T, typically including std::bad_alloc.

summary: Creates an object of the given type T by means of uses-allocator construction at the uninitialized memory location indicated by p.

recommendedExamples.title: Related example: std::make_unique, std::make_unique_for_overwrite
